faq.title: Answers to the questions we get most

items.title: Do you charge seafarers a fee?
items.text: No. Placement is paid by the principal. Under MLC 2006, no manning agency may charge a seafarer for recruitment or placement.

items.title: How long does registration take?
items.text: The form takes about five minutes. Document verification is usually completed within two working days.

items.title: Which ranks do you place?
items.text: Deck, engine, and hotel ranks from ratings to master and chief engineer, across container, tanker, gas, bulk, offshore, and cruise tonnage.

items.title: How fast can a crew request be answered?
items.text: A first shortlist is typically returned within one working day of receiving a complete specification.

stepsSeafarers.title: How registration works
stepsSeafarers.lede: Most placements complete within four to six weeks of a complete profile.

items.title: Register
items.text: Complete the registration form with your rank, vessel experience, and certificate status. Upload a CV or sea service record.

items.title: Verification
items.text: Our crewing team reviews your documents and confirms which flag endorsements you still need.

items.title: Interview
items.text: A technical interview with the principal's superintendent, plus a Marlins or equivalent English test.

items.title: Joining
items.text: Contract signed under MLC 2006, visa and endorsement processed, ticket issued, joining confirmed in writing.

stepsPrincipals.title: How a crew request runs
stepsPrincipals.lede: From your specification to joining, typically under 30 days for ratings and 45 days for senior officers.

items.title: Send the specification
items.text: Ranks, vessel type, flag, joining port, and contract terms. A short call confirms the standing orders and interview format.

items.title: Candidate proposal
items.text: Within 24 hours we return a shortlist with CVs, certificate status, sea service, and Marlins scores.

items.title: Interview and selection
items.text: Interviews arranged around your time zone. We coordinate technical assessments and reference checks.

items.title: Mobilisation
items.text: Contract, visa, flag endorsement, medical, and travel handled end to end, with a joining report before departure.

stepsEmergency.title: Four steps from gap to gangway
stepsEmergency.lede: A 24/7 duty desk receives the request, pulls a verified stand-by from the pool, and handles documentation and travel in parallel so the joining date doesn't slip.

items.title: 1 · Request received
items.text: The duty desk acknowledges inside 30 minutes and confirms the rank, vessel, port, and target joining.

items.title: 2 · Candidate proposed
items.text: Within 6 hours we send 1–3 verified stand-bys with valid Seaman's Book, CoC, medical, and visas already checked.

items.title: 3 · Travel booked
items.text: Flights, hotel, and shore transfer booked same day. Flag-state and port-state notifications prepared.

items.title: 4 · Handover complete
items.text: Relief crew signs on at the agreed port; handover brief with outgoing officer documented for the master.
